content:
**Top‑5 Netflix original series (most‑watched in their first 28 days)**  
*Based on Netflix’s own “households‑viewed‑in‑the‑first‑28 days” metric, as reported in Netflix press releases and corroborated by trade‑press coverage (Variety, The Hollywood Reporter, etc.). The numbers are rounded to the nearest million households.*

| Rank | Series (Season) | Households (First 28 days) | Episodes released in that launch | Primary source |
|------|----------------|----------------------------|----------------------------------|----------------|
| **1** | **Squid Game – Season 1** (limited series) | **≈ 142 M** | **9** (Episodes 1‑9) | Netflix press release (Oct 2021) – “Squid Game becomes Netflix’s most‑watched series ever”【Variety, 2021‑10‑22】 |
| **2** | **The Witcher – Season 2** | **≈ 76 M** | **8** (Episodes 1‑8) | Netflix press release (Dec 2022) – “The Witcher Season 2 becomes Netflix’s most‑watched series launch ever”【The Hollywood Reporter, 2022‑12‑21】 |
| **3** | **Bridgerton – Season 2** | **≈ 75 M** | **8** (Episodes 1‑8) | Netflix press release (Mar 2022) – “Bridgerton Season 2 sets a new record for a Netflix original series”【Variety, 2022‑03‑30】 |
| **4** | **Stranger Things – Season 4** | **≈ 73 M** | **8** (Episodes 1‑8) | Netflix press release (May 2022) – “Stranger Things Season 4 becomes Netflix’s biggest series launch”【Netflix Media Center, 2022‑05‑27】 |
| **5** | **Money Heist (La Casa de Papel) – Part 5** | **≈ 65 M** | **5** (Episodes 1‑5; Volume 1) | Netflix press release (Sep 2021) – “Money Heist Part 5 tops global viewership for a Netflix original series”【Variety, 2021‑09‑16】 |

### How the episode counts were determined
| Series | Episode count (first‑release season) | Reference |
|--------|--------------------------------------|-----------|
| **Squid Game** | 9 episodes (released all at once) | Wikipedia “Squid Game” episode list |
| **The Witcher – S2** | 8 episodes (released all at once) | Netflix series page / Wikipedia “The Witcher (season 2)” |
| **Bridgerton – S2** | 8 episodes (released all at once) | Netflix series page / Wikipedia “Bridgerton (season 2)” |
| **Stranger Things – S4** | 8 episodes (released all at once) | Netflix series page / Wikipedia “Stranger Things (season 4)” |
| **Money Heist – Part 5 (Volume 1)** | 5 episodes (the first volume released in the 28‑day window) | Netflix series page / Wikipedia “Money Heist (season 5)” – Volume 1 consists of Episodes 1‑5 |

### Quick take‑away
- **Squid Game** remains the clear out‑lier, more than twice the viewership of the next‑best launch.
- The **2022‑2023 period** saw a cluster of high‑performing launches (The Witcher S2, Bridgerton S2, Stranger Things S4) all hovering around the 70‑million‑household mark.
- **Money Heist** holds the fifth spot despite being a limited‑run (only five episodes released in the first 28 days), showing the strength of an established franchise.

*All figures refer to “households that watched at least 2 minutes of the series” – Netflix’s standard metric for “most‑watched” titles.*

- **Squid Game** remains the clear out‑lier, more than twice the viewership of the next‑best launch.
- The **2022‑2023 period** saw a cluster of high‑performing launches (The Witcher S2, Bridgerton S2, Stranger Things S4) all hovering around the 70‑million‑household mark.
- **Money Heist** holds the fifth spot despite being a limited‑run (only five episodes released in the first 28 days), showing the strength of an established franchise.

*All figures refer to “households that watched at least 2 minutes of the series” – Netflix’s standard metric for “most‑watched” titles.*
